Muster Werkzeugbau GmbH is a family-owned manufacturer with our own factory in Stuttgart. Established in 1978, we employ 120 - 180 employees and export to Germany, France, the United States and the United Arab Emirates.

Our plant is ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified. All products carry CE marking and are RoHS compliant.

Wholesale and OEM enquiries welcome.
